Replace position numbered buttons with player tiles showing position label + stack depth. Active tile in brand green (#00C853) with glow effect, inactive tiles in dark gray (#2A2A2A) with white text. Updated mobile responsive CSS. 387 tests pass, build clean.

Added top bar with Cash/bb/spots/Upgrade — game type label, stack depth dropdown (30-200bb), spots counter (2,000+), green-outlined Upgrade CTA. #1A1A1A bg, #333 border. Responsive wrapping on mobile. 368 tests pass, build clean.

Added action prompt header row between position tiles and hand matrix. Shows 'Your action: [RAISE/CALL/FOLD]' with GTO frequency from selected hand or most-frequent position action. Displays pot size (3.0bb) and effective stack. Color-coded action label, reactive to position/board/street changes. 368 tests pass, frontend build clean.

Implemented Filters sub-tab with hand category checkboxes (Pairs, Suited, Offsuit, Broadway, Ace High) and blocker rank buttons (A/K/Q/J/T). Filtered hands dim to opacity 0.08, blocked hands to 0.15. Dynamic hand count shown. 368 tests pass, frontend build clean, live 200.

Replaced Math.random() placeholder in OOP EV column with real weighted-average solver equity from rangeData. Computes weighted average of per-hand equity × frequency, converts to bb EV: (avgEquity - 0.5) * 3. Green for positive, red for negative. Shows — when solver data unavailable. 368 tests pass, build clean, live 200.

Root copy (hoisted from Next.js transitive dep) conflicted with e2e-local copy. Fix makes root copy inert. 116/118 e2e tests pass (2 pre-existing failures), 368 poker-core tests pass, build clean, live 200.

Replaced mockSpot() with real quiz API data. Added QuizSpot/QuizOption interfaces, quizToSpot() converter that derives is_gto from gto_action. API failure shows error state with Retry button instead of fake data. Build passes, 368 tests pass.
GTO frequency micro-chips with threshold coloring on postflop action buttons. Green >20%, yellow 5-20%, gray <5%. 368 tests pass, build clean.

Added response caching layer (apps/api/services/cache.py) with TTL-based in-memory/fakeredis caching. Wired init_cache(app) into main.py. Applied @cached(ttl=300) to GET /api/v1/courses and /featured, @cached(ttl=600) to GET /api/v1/quiz/categories. All endpoints already met <200ms targets; caching further improves latency (courses: 14ms→2ms). 387 tests pass, build clean, live 200.
